findingClass: a POSTPONED IPO whose postponement time is unknown (ipos.postponed_at NULL: postponed before #1304 and no status provenance row to backfill from) never receives the §2.9 / OD-120 automatic relaunch clear, so its old admin values survive a relaunch unless an admin reviews them; or the trigger ipos_stamp_postponed_at is missing and every new postponement stays unknown
failThreshold: FAIL when the trigger ipos_stamp_postponed_at is absent from pg_trigger; WARN with every such IPO listed by slug (never a bare count) when any visible POSTPONED IPO has postponed_at NULL; PASS when none.
unverifiableWhen: ipos.postponed_at is not present on the audited database (#1304 migration not applied).
note: Implemented in scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs (checkD_postponedAtUnknown). The write side is structural: the migration's trigger stamps ipos.postponed_at on the database clock on every write that moves status to POSTPONED; scraper/scripts/backfill-postponed-at.ts fills existing rows from the status provenance row and lists the rest. This check is the admin's list of the unknown ones (spec §2.9, clarified 2026-10-01).
